context_for_next_testing_agent: BTP Facture migrated from FastAPI/MongoDB to Supabase-only frontend. All data now comes directly from Supabase PostgreSQL. Auth uses Supabase Auth. Two critical bugs fixed in this iteration: ProfileCompletionCard and SettingsPage. Minor data issues remain with dates showing 'Invalid Date' and some prices showing 'NaN'. All 11 main pages work: Dashboard, Clients, Chantiers, Devis, Factures, Finances, Bibliothèque, Assistant IA, Services Pro, Abonnement, Paramètres.
